headline: Cal State LA win four and concede nothing
dek: Cal State LA have won all four of their matches, scoring seven goals and conceding none, and no other side in the conference has kept its sheet clean that long. Cal State Monterey Bay have also won every match they have played, but have not kept the goals out.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fresno Pacific's 22 goals are more than Cal State Monterey Bay and Menlo have scored together, and eight different players have shared them.

wire.line: UC Merced have played three matches and drawn every one of them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches have passed their date with no result recorded, the earliest on the season's opening day and the latest in August.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State East Bay have conceded twenty goals, more than any other programme, and have yet to win.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cal State San Bernardino have won three and drawn two, and have conceded two goals across them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cal State Dominguez Hills' defeat to Texas A&M International leaves them with one win, two draws and two defeats, and the win came on the road at Vanguard.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Zion Vaughn has scored six goals from thirteen shots for Fresno Pacific.

last_match.line: Cal State Dominguez Hills have now conceded in every match they have played this season.

next_match.line: Point Loma have already faced Cal Poly Pomona, Cal State San Bernardino and Cal State Dominguez Hills without losing; Cal State Monterey Bay have yet to drop a point.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
